rows.objection: The 255/300/345 MPa cases are assumed compressive sensitivities. The 345 MPa maker minimum is tensile; 036 found no matched finished-gauge biaxial compressive minimum. Catalog offset-yield strengths do not establish the first microscopic plastic onset; the model explicitly idealizes them as onset stresses.
rows.proposed_fix: Test the formed, etched, joined sheet in both in-plane directions and relevant stress states; establish an allowable and plastic curve.

rows.objection: nu=.0768 comes from thicker cross-rolled sheet, while scalar E=290 GPa and isotropic J2 ignore texture, tension/compression asymmetry and through-thickness differences.
rows.proposed_fix: Use measured orthotropic elasticity and a supported anisotropic yield law; retain .03/.33 as sensitivities only.

rows.objection: The last converged pressure of a load-controlled solve is not a validated collapse pressure. Perfect-plastic tangent singularity and numerical cutbacks can stop the path.
rows.proposed_fix: Use a validated continuation/dynamic method, mesh and increment convergence, and a matching physical test before assigning ultimate capacity.

rows.objection: Perfect plasticity has no matched Be hardening/ductility/fracture basis. First yield and numerical endpoints answer different questions.
rows.proposed_fix: Keep the strict no-yield criterion; measure the actual compression curve and fracture limits before crediting redistribution.

rows.objection: 029 overpredicted a different steel/PVC hemisphere by about 10% linearly and 2.31–2.46 times at imperfect nonlinear endpoints. Adding face plasticity does not itself establish a matched benchmark. CHECK-029 independently identifies the nonlinear benchmark gap as a StVK foam-law/core-refinement artifact; its linear-radius explanation is still unestablished.
rows.proposed_fix: Reproduce the complete benchmark constitutive, geometric and solution definitions, then validate a relevant low-Vc Be/CR-III test. Treat transferred ratios as conditional scenarios.

rows.objection: The 037b 3.410 MPa cold face compression is represented only by a separate strength-debit screen; its residual shape and geometric stiffness are not solved.
rows.proposed_fix: Couple measured cure/relaxation behavior, effective core membrane stiffness and shell prestress; preserve self-equilibrium.

rows.objection: CHECK-029 demonstrates ellipticity loss in the inherited 0.01/0.005-MPa in-plane StVK core. Final conditional boundaries use an explicit 1/0.5-MPa regularization with an own sufficient local ellipticity check; these in-plane moduli are not measured core properties.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure the actual curved core and bond, include nonlinear core laws and disbond sensitivities; use the 038 grounding tests.

rows.objection: W and L axisymmetric surrogates rotate material directions around the pole and omit general nonaxisymmetric modes and panel/seam geometry.
rows.proposed_fix: Run a converged 3D model of the actual core orientation, seams, defects and supports. Do not call the two surrogates universal bounds.

rows.objection: A single Gaussian RMS is diluted by the full sphere area. Reflector dish RMS, core-to-face fit, peak contour error and one localized dimple are not interchangeable.
rows.proposed_fix: Specify defect amplitude, footprint and spatial spectrum; scan actual geometry and pass it to the shell model. Keep one-dimple RMS explicitly conditional.

rows.objection: 042 precedents use different materials, gauges, supports, sizes and shape metrics. Its 0.15 mm reflector-class peak is a three-sigma projection.
rows.proposed_fix: Demonstrate the full formed Be blank, bond and in-place seam; measure both local and global shape before treating a precedent as an achievable hull tolerance.

rows.objection: The endpoint converges faster than the maximum integration-point face stress near the pole. A coarse-grid first-yield estimate can move the inferred tolerance.
rows.proposed_fix: Use the filed mesh/step boundary checks and their brackets; avoid precision beyond those checks. Retain both-face integration-point histories.

rows.objection: The reported amplitude boundary is on the tested Gaussian-defect branch, with fixed material and perfect interfaces. It is not a global optimum over all defects or installed-hull safety proof.
rows.proposed_fix: Validate the actual defect spectrum and coupled failure modes; test the built shell before assigning installed SF.

rows.objection: Core shear is now screened against Hexcel Table II minimum-average and typical values with a stated quadratic interaction. Catalog plate-shear tests at 0.625-inch thickness do not qualify this curved 23.237-mm core, its density, adhesive, temperature, seams or scatter.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure L/W shear and crushing of the actual curved core/bond stack; establish installed allowables and a supported failure law.
rows.disposition: Computed conditional screen; qualification remains open

rows.objection: A positive sufficient local acoustic bound verifies the selected regularized StVK law at saved passing states only. It does not establish global or nonaxisymmetric stability, and changing an unsourced regularization does not repair the missing material characterization.
rows.proposed_fix: Use measured in-plane stiffness and a well-posed finite-strain cellular constitutive law, then test geometric and material instabilities with a converged 3D model.
rows.disposition: Inherited-law acceptance withdrawn; regularized result is a projection
